tuition.note: Free for EU/EEA and Swiss citizens; non-EU fees for English-taught degrees are about €8,000–18,000 a year

programmes.description: Light and camera work shapes emotion, meaning, and how stories are seen. This major explores cinematography through hands-on film productions, visual- and lighting design, visual storytelling, and collaboration with directors and other technically and artistically responsible crew members. You develop a strong artistic voice and technical expertise for career as a cinematographer in film and media.

programmes.name: Collaborative and Industrial Design, Master of Arts (Art and Design) (2 yrs)

tuition.note: Free for EU/EEA and Swiss citizens; non-EU fees for English-taught degrees are about €8,000–18,000 a year

programmes.description: Products and services are most successful when people create them together. This major focuses on collaborative design processes and industrial design, from concept design through prototyping to implementation. Work with end users, experts, and industry partners to develop sustainable, human-centred solutions that address challenges in society and business.

programmes.name: Contemporary Design, Master of Arts (Art and Design) (2 yrs)

tuition.note: Free for EU/EEA and Swiss citizens; non-EU fees for English-taught degrees are about €8,000–18,000 a year

programmes.description: Design can question, provoke, and reshape society. This major explores critical and experimental design practices, from speculative concepts to material explorations and exhibitions. Develop your own design position while working across disciplines and addressing complex social, cultural, and environmental issues.

programmes.name: Costume Design: Performing Arts and Film, Master of Arts (Art and Design) (2 yrs)

tuition.note: Free for EU/EEA and Swiss citizens; non-EU fees for English-taught degrees are about €8,000–18,000 a year

programmes.description: Would you like to develop your vision and career as a costume designer? This major fosters the future costume design professionals for live performance, film, and digital media. You will explore costume design through conceptual thinking, material exploration, research, and hands-on collaboration with directors, performers and other designers in real-life productions.
